{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only completed orders (status == 'completed')
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify the filter worked
print(f"Total completed orders: {len(df_completed)}")
print(f"Total refunded orders: {len(df) - len(df_completed)}")

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment on completed orders only
conversion_rate = df_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate.max()

# Output the result
print(f"Conversion rates by segment (completed orders only):\n{conversion_rate}")
print(f"\nHighest conversion rate: {best_segment} ({best_rate})")"}
